goal: Five more resident kinds of Hotel Endless (#9651) as rigged, animated humanoid models: Tripo P2, humanoid rig v1.0, retargeted presets.
style: Single full-body character for image-to-3D reconstruction and humanoid rigging: an uncanny resident of an impossible 1970s hotel, grounded slightly stylized realism, worn tactile fabrics, muted burgundy, olive, amber and ivory palette, unsettling but not gory. Standing in a neutral A-pose: straight legs slightly apart, arms held out and down at about 45 degrees away from the body, open hands, fingers together, nothing held in the hands, nothing touching the body. Straight-on front view at eye level, the whole figure in frame from head to feet with generous margin, centred, nothing cropped. Plain flat light-grey seamless background, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no ground, no props, no other figures. Solid opaque materials, no glow, no transparency. NO text, NO letters, NO logos. Square image around 1024x1024.

pieces.bellboy: Subject: The Bellboy, a small slight figure the height of a twelve-year-old in a short fitted scarlet bellhop jacket with a row of brass buttons and gold piping, a scarlet pillbox cap with a chin strap, black trousers with a gold side stripe and polished black shoes. His face is a smooth porcelain doll's face, glazed ivory, with painted dark eyes and a tiny painted mouth.
pieces.chef: Subject: The Night Chef, a very large heavy-set figure in stained double-breasted white chef's whites and a long grey apron, a tall pleated white toque, checked trousers and black kitchen clogs, thick forearms with rolled sleeves. His whole head and face are wrapped tightly in strips of grey kitchen cloth like a bandage, leaving no features.
pieces.concierge: Subject: The Concierge, a tall gaunt man in an immaculate black tailcoat, a dove-grey waistcoat, a high wing collar with a black cravat, white cotton gloves and a pair of small crossed golden keys pinned to each lapel. His face is perfectly smooth and featureless, grey like unfired clay, his dark hair slicked flat.
pieces.sleepwalker: Subject: The Sleepwalker, a lost hotel guest: a middle-aged man in faded blue-and-cream striped cotton pyjamas and a long untied maroon dressing gown, barefoot, a quilted black satin sleep mask over his eyes, thinning grey hair standing up as if from a pillow.
pieces.bride: Subject: The Bride, a tall slender figure in a long yellowed ivory wedding dress with a high lace collar and long lace sleeves, the hem frayed and grey with dust, white gloves, a long torn ivory veil falling over her face and down to her waist so no face is visible.

meshProducer: asset-pipeline tools/tripo/tripo.py generate (P2); humanoid rig v1.0-20240301 and one retarget per preset
